meta.description: Registry for bounded admissibility-preserving composition behavior between delta, Pi_A, and NavT in Phase 3.

delta_composition_closure_entries.name: Delta Composition Closure
delta_composition_closure_entries.purpose: Represent bounded admissibility-preserving composition behavior between delta, Pi_A, and NavT across recursive continuation structures.

composition_conditions.name: delta_composition_with_pi_a_remains_defined
composition_conditions.description: Admissibility projection must be formally composable with delta proposal logic.

composition_conditions.name: delta_composition_with_navt_remains_admissible
composition_conditions.description: Transported states resulting from delta proposal must satisfy nonlocal admissibility window constraints.

composition_conditions.name: composition_does_not_force_unique_continuation
composition_conditions.description: Combining operators does not bypass the fundamental multi-valued nature of process actualization.

composition_conditions.name: multi_valued_delta_structure_preserved
composition_conditions.description: The ability of delta to propose multiple concurrent candidates is maintained across composition.

composition_conditions.name: noninvertible_transport_preserved_under_composition
composition_conditions.description: Composition with delta or Pi_A does not recover unique preimages for NavT.

composition_conditions.name: recursive_composition_updates_remain_bounded
composition_conditions.description: Iteration of the (delta, Pi_A, NavT) composite sequence stays within stable basin thresholds.

composition_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_composition_witness
composition_conditions.description: Pruning within the composite chain must not eliminate all possible continuation paths.

composition_conditions.name: composition_instability_detectable
composition_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to register breakdown in operator identity or closure under composition.
